name: Form Field
summary: A form field is a label, a control, a hint and an error message wired together. Every other input in this library reuses it. The hard part is `aria-describedby`: it is a list of ids, and the usual bug is one line of JavaScript that overwrites it with the error id and silently deletes the hint.
demoNote: Tab into Work email and straight out again, then type something without an @. The error is announced, and the hint stays in aria-describedby the whole time.

contract.useWhen: A label, a hint and an error on one control, wired so both stay announced.
keyboard: native: one stop for the control. Leaving it is when to validate, never on every keystroke
states: invalid — aria-invalid=true only while a message shows
failureModes: aria-describedby overwritten with the error id, which deletes the hint
the error element created on demand, so it is not in the tree when the text lands
a placeholder used as the label, gone the moment anyone types
aria-invalid left true after the field is fixed, so the state and the styling disagree
validation on every keystroke, which announces a half-typed value as wrong
api: AC.createField(root, options) -> { check, setError, clearError, isInvalid, focus, destroy }
